PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
MINUTES

Due to the July 4" holiday, a meeting of the Public Services Committee was instead held on
Wednesday, July 5, 2023, in Committee Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:04
p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Bryan Cook, Chairman, Dr. Aldrich, Pete Laybourn, and Dr. Rinne.
Absent: Tom Segrave

AGENDA ITEMS

8 ORDINANCE ~2™ READING ~ Creating Chapter 2.96, Ethical Obligations of Public
Officials, Public Members and City Employees, of Title 2, Administration and Personnel,
of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, specifying the ethical duties
and obligations of Public Officials, Public Members and Employees of the City of
Cheyenne. (POSTPONED FROM JUNE 26,2023)

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 2"! reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Dr. Aldrich moved to
amend section 2,96.050(A)(2) to strike the words “Advocate or” and in section 2.96.060 to strike
in the 1* sentence “or the removal of a public official or public member from his or her office or
position”, seconded by Mr. Laybourn, Motion to amend carried by unanimous voice vote, Dr.
Rinne moved to amend by substitute dated July 5, 2023. Motion to amend died due to the lack of
asecond. Dr. Rinne moved strike section 2.96.040(B), seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion to amend
carried by unanimous voice vote. Dr. Aldrich moved to amend existing City Code section 2.52.010
to insert “in Chapter 2.96 of city code or” after the phrase “Unless otherwise provided”, seconded
by Mr. Laybourn, Motion to amend carried by unanimous voice vote. Main motion, as amended,
carried by unanimous voice vote.

John Brodie, Deputy City Attomey, provided a staff report and committee members Aldrich,
Layboum, and Rinne commented on the item.

9. ORDINANCE -3" READING ~ Amending Chapter 15.20, National Electrical Code
Adopted-Appendix K, International Building Code-Administrative Provisions Adopted, of
Title 15, Buildings and Construction, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne,
Wyoming, updating the Incorporated National Electrical Code Provisions as specified.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Antony Pomerleau, Chief Building Inspector, provided a staff report.

10. | ORDINANCE -3" READING - Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
located northwest of and adjacent to the intersection of Thomas Road and Ridge Road.
